title: Docs wrap-up: chapter status, README flip, wiki page, board close-out
description:
**Files:** `src/spec/ch02_querying.rs` (status sections); `src/lib.rs` (chapter index line for querying — drop the stale "(specified next)"); `README.md` (status FAQ + mermaid "planned" labels flipped for what landed; the future CLI verbs stay described as planned under the CLI epic BOTSPY-7c2705); `project/wiki/store.md` (new: store path, WAL, DDL v1, refresh model, embedder seam, model-id policy).

**Acceptance:** docs-coverage guardrail green; no stale "planned" claims about landed behavior; `kbs wiki render` on the new page is clean; the landed epics are closed with DoD comments (the MiniLM epic stays open and blocked on its gate).

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Starting the README portion of this wrap-up task (directed by Ryan): replace README.md with a real user-facing README before the first crates.io release. Plan: fresh worktree `docs/readme` from origin/develop, verify every CLI example against a build from develop, rewrite README (agents + data locations, install, usage, local-only, license, docs/spec links), keep existing material (press-release content moves to docs/ if referenced), no export mention, then PR to develop and merge once green.

comments.author: home
comments.text: README flip done (PR #6, merged to develop as 4e07a2e): README.md replaced with a real user-facing README — what BotSpy does, the five supported agents and where each one's data lives, cargo install botspy --locked with per-OS prerequisites, verified usage examples for botspy sources / doctor / sessions (--since, -o json) / show, local-only guarantees, MIT license, links to docs.rs and the features/ spec. Every example was run against the CLI built from develop over the committed synthetic fixture corpus (no real session content or paths; the sample outputs state that they come from the synthetic corpus). No export mention. The old press-release narrative and detailed FAQ moved verbatim to docs/DESIGN.md with an editorial note on which CLI verbs shipped. Gates green locally: fmt, clippy -D warnings, cargo test, cargo test --test bdd (169 passed / 2 skipped), spec_docs_coverage; cargo package --list still includes README.md and Cargo.toml readme field unchanged. CI green on the PR and on develop after merge. Remaining parts of this task (chapter status, wiki page, board close-out) still open.
